title: Concurso 36/2012 — Comunidad authority / capacity / standing / personación matrix

governance.absence_rule: NOT LOCATED IN THE PRESENT CONTROLLED CORPUS does not mean DID NOT EXIST / DID NOT OCCUR.
governance.criminal_boundary: Criminal/prosecutorial allegations remain allegations unless judicially established. No row is a finding of guilt.
governance.denominator_boundary: This matrix is exhaustive for the actors/entities identified in this controlled authority review; it is not a certified complete judicial docket. A signed/certified complete docket and all poderes/personaciones remain required to establish a negative proposition conclusively.

rows.actor_entity: Comunidad de Propietarios Sun Park / generic ‘Comunidad’ label
natural_persons: Must be resolved incident-by-incident from the ACTA, communication, filing, power or representation relied upon
rows.claimed_role: Owners’ community / collective body; at different points the corpus attributes voting, fee/quota, security, access, common-area and representation acts to a ‘Comunidad’.
rows.legal_form: Community of owners / horizontal-property body; exact identity and governing composition must be proved for each date and act.
rows.authority_relied_upon: ACTAs, resolutions, office-holding, powers and/or asserted owner-community authority depending on incident. The label alone is never proof of authority.
rows.formally_personated_in_36_2012: NOT LOCATED IN THE PRESENT CONTROLLED CORPUS as a complete, certified, date-resolved personación record.
rows.document_establishing_standing: No single canonical poder/personación instrument has yet been located that answers every material Community intervention. Audit remains open.
rows.court_ac_treatment: The corpus contains judicial/AC references to ‘Comunidad’; every such reference requires a separate identity/authority/reliance/effect audit rather than normalization.
rows.procedural_effect: Potentially material where a Community representation was received, relied upon, transmitted or given effect; exact effect is incident-specific.
rows.patrimonial_effect: Potential effects on LPB, the estate, hotel access/operation, expenditure, income and third-party property require incident-level proof.
rows.criminal_legal_issue: Working allegation: possible unauthorized or misleading use of Community identity/authority. Requires proof of actor, authority, representation, deception/knowledge where relevant, reliance, effect and prejudice.

rows.actor_entity: 3205/2014 — source-reported Community-capacity complainant and affected party
natural_persons: Source-reported president / complainant — contextual candidate PD-SP-P-0004 (Asunción Aizpurúa Sánchez); primary source form strengthens but does not silently merge the bridge
Source-reported administrator / affected party — contextual candidate PD-SP-P-0009 (Francisco Mario Matos Matas); shortened primary source form remains controlled
rows.claimed_role: The contemporaneous complaint records one complainant who claimed to attend as Community president and one affected party described as administrator; these are source-reported/claimed titles, not legitimate office, and the complaint does not record two formal complainants.
rows.legal_form: Natural persons; whether either acted personally or for an exactly identified Community legal person is unresolved.
rows.authority_relied_upon: The complainant invoked Community president/administrator titles and said they attended to carry out unspecified work. Gil directly alleges that neither person held legitimate office or work authority. No date-effective appointment, resolution, mandate, work order, owner consent, funding authority or exact Community legal person is established.
rows.formally_personated_in_36_2012: NO CONCURSO 36/2012 PERSONACIÓN INFERENCE PERMITTED. 3205/2014 is separate, and no source establishes either person's personation in Concurso 36/2012 from this incident.
rows.document_establishing_standing: PARTIAL: primary complaint/citation and historical appointment context located; incident-date office, exact Community, mandate, work order, access authority and personation remain open.
acts_attributed: complaint-maker's claimed use of Community president and administrator descriptions
reported entry after an access problem and refusal to leave while police mediation was requested
reported inspection of owners' apartments and key dispute
rows.court_ac_treatment: A court summons scheduled an oral hearing; occurrence and outcome are not located. No insolvency-administration or Concurso treatment is inferred.
rows.procedural_effect: A separate Arrecife minor-offence proceeding is documented; counsel/personation, hearing occurrence, disposition, appeal and finality remain unresolved.
rows.patrimonial_effect: NOT ESTABLISHED; no estate or patrimonial effect is inferred from the access/key incident.
rows.evidence_status: PRIMARY COMPLAINT AND OFFICIAL SUMMONS LOCATED / INCIDENT-DATE AUTHORITY, CORROBORATION AND OUTCOME OPEN
rows.criminal_legal_issue: Gil alleges criminal hijacking/capture and holding out of Community authority; a 7-Oct-2014 email proves that counter-allegation existed contemporaneously, not that it was true. Test office, mandate, entry, inspection, key control, first physical act, complaint truth and intent separately. The complaint attributes no direct physical act to Gil. It does not prove injury causation, false complaint, abuse of process, agreement, shadow administration, wrongdoing or liability; genuine Community/owner access, personal access, excessive entry and mutual or defensive confrontation remain live alternatives.
